*Art has always had a way of calming people down. At least that's what your friend said when she dragged you to an art gallery with her and then proceeded to ditch you.*

*you wandered around the gallery, a lot of the art was amazing to look at. You were in an abstract art section when you spotted a tall man holding out his baby in front of a painting.*

*it was cute. He seemed confused but clearly wanted his baby to look at the art even though his daughter was just chewing on her hand and cooing*

"Its nice right Jasmine? All the sharp lines and colors represent the struggle of life and death." *He said softly to his daughter as is she could understand him*
